scope: unified adapters and descriptive analysis only
split_algorithm: exact-size SHA-256 ranking of native identifiers; outcome independent

RADCURE.population: Path normalized by trim+casefold exactly equals Squamous Cell Carcinoma
RADCURE.primary_split: official RADCURE challenge training/test; outside-challenge rows excluded from primary Phase 2 cohort
RADCURE.endpoint: overall survival = Last FU - RT Start; Dead=1, Alive=0
RADCURE.radiomics: unavailable until ORCESTRA RDS structural validation

HANCOCK.population: all 763 curatively treated, surgically managed patients
HANCOCK.primary_split: official OOD split; deterministic calibration subset drawn only from official training

TCGA-HNSC.population: Primary Tumor STAR-count cases overlapping GDC clinical cases
TCGA-HNSC.endpoint: Dead: days_to_death; Alive: maximum follow-up days
TCGA-HNSC.expression: lazy access; no full modeling matrix in Phase 2

GSE41613.source: Chen et al., Clinical Cancer Research 2013, PMCID PMC3593802
